# Speak-Up

Speak-Up merupakan sistem whistleblowing PermataBank untuk melaporkan pelanggaran atau potensi pelanggaran, baik berupa fraud, korupsi, konflik kepentingan, perlakuan tidak etis, maupun pelanggaran Kode Etik, termasuk kecurigaan atas tindakan pelanggaran. Setiap laporan Speak-Up yang diterima dikelola oleh Administrator Speak-Up, PIC Speak-Up, dan Speak-Up Council yang ditunjuk oleh PermataBank.

PermataBank menyediakan jalur pelaporan Speak-Up melalui:

- Situs Web: http://bit.ly/pb-speak-up
- Surat Elektronik: speak.up@permatabank.co.id
- Telepon, SMS atau WhatsApp: 0811-2937-133
- PO BOX: 4890 JKTM 12700

Mekanisme Sistem Whistleblowing (Speak-Up) di PermataBank dilakukan dengan memperhatikan prinsip-prinsip berikut:

- Laporan bersifat rahasia. Hanya Administrator Speak-Up, PIC Speak-Up, dan Speak-Up Council yang mempunyai wewenang untuk mengetahui isi laporan.
- Pelapor dapat memilih 1 dari 3 prinsip anonim, yaitu: full disclosure, partial anonymity, atau anonymous.
- Pihak pelapor berhak mendapatkan perlindungan dari PermataBank apabila dari laporannya mengakibatkan sesuatu hal yang mengancam keberadaan pelapor.
- Pihak pelapor dibebaskan dari segala sanksi bila ternyata laporannya tidak dapat dibuktikan kebenarannya.
- PermataBank menjamin semua pihak pelapor bahwa laporan-laporan mereka tidak akan mempengaruhi penilaian kinerja dan/atau perjalanan karier mereka di PermataBank.
- Dengan jaminan tersebut di atas, diharapkan pihak pelapor bersedia memberikan informasi yang lebih terperinci kepada manajemen terkait tindak lanjut atas laporan mereka.

Selama tahun 2021, Administrator Speak-Up menerima 17 laporan, di mana 7 laporan bersifat umum atau keluh kesah, 8 laporan berindikasi pelanggaran ketentuan Kode Etik, dan 2 laporan berindikasi fraud. Laporan-laporan tersebut telah ditindaklanjuti oleh PIC Speak-Up dan dilaporkan secara berkala kepada Speak-Up Council dan Direksi PermataBank. Seluruh laporan tersebut telah ditindaklanjuti.

# Speak-Up

Speak-Up is PermataBank's whistleblowing system to report violations or potential violations, whether in the form of fraud, corruption, conflicts of interest, unethical treatment, or violation of the Code of Conduct, including suspicion of violations. Each Speak-Up report received is managed by the Speak-Up Administrator, Speak-Up PIC, and Speak-Up Council appointed by PermataBank.

PermataBank provides its Speak-Up channels via:

- E-mail: speak.up@permatabank.co.id
- Phone, SMS or WhatsApp: 0811-2937-133
- PO BOX: 4890 JKTM 12700

The Whistleblowing System mechanism (Speak-Up) at PermataBank is implemented with due observance of the following principles:

- Confidential report. Only the Speak-Up Administrators, Speak-Up PIC, and Speak-Up council have the authority to access the contents of the report.
- A whistleblower may choose 1 from 3 principles of anonymity, namely: full disclosure, partial anonymity, or anonymous.
- The reporting party is entitled to protection from PermataBank if the report leads to potential threats to the whistleblower.
- The whistleblower will not be held accountable if his/her report is unproven.
- PermataBank guarantees that the report submitted by a whistleblower will not affect his/her performance evaluation/ career in PermataBank.
- With such guarantee, the whistleblower is expected to provide detailed information to the management related to follow-ups concerning their reports.

# Manajemen Risiko Fraud

Fraud merupakan salah satu risiko penting dalam kegiatan perbankan, terjadinya fraud dapat mengakibatkan kerugian finansial berkaitan dengan risiko keuangan dan kerugian non-finansial dari risiko reputasi yang dapat mengurangi kepercayaan publik kepada Bank. Kerangka kerja manajemen risiko fraud termuat dalam Kebijakan Strategi Anti-Fraud yang meliputi aktivitas pencegahan, pendeteksian, pemberian tanggapan, proses investigasi dan efek jera yang dijabarkan dalam strategi yang lengkap untuk mengelola risiko fraud di PermataBank dalam rangka mencapai level tertinggi dalam hal integritas bisnis. Tanggung jawab manajemen risiko fraud berada di bawah unit kerja Fraud Risk Management (FRM), Direktorat Hukum dan Kepatuhan. [GRI 103-1]

Pencegahan kemungkinan terjadinya fraud di PermataBank, di antaranya dilakukan dengan cara:

a) Menerbitkan fraud alert berupa tulisan yang disebarkan melalui surat elektronik berisi informasi kepada seluruh karyawan tentang tren/ modus kejahatan fraud yang berkembang dengan tujuan membangun kepedulian dan kesadaran terhadap risiko fraud.
b) Melalui webinar dan e-learning Anti-Fraud, yakni salah satu pelatihan daring untuk meningkatkan kepedulian terhadap fraud dalam bentuk diskusi, animasi disertai pertanyaan, yang wajib diikuti oleh seluruh karyawan PermataBank.
c) Pelatihan/sharing session internal yang dilakukan oleh unit kerja FRM untuk pembelajaran risiko dan bentuk/tren fraud perbankan. [GRI 103-2]

# Fraud Risk Management

Fraud is one of the key risks in banking activities, fraud occurrence may lead to financial losses in relations to financial risk and non-financial losses in relations to reputation risk, which will reduce the confidence level of the public towards the Bank. The framework of fraud risk management is contained in the Anti-Fraud Strategy Policy, covering the activities of prevention, detection, response, investigation process, and deterrent effect, which is described in a comprehensive strategy to manage fraud risk in PermataBank in order to reach the highest level in terms of business integrity. The responsibility for fraud risk management is under the Fraud Risk Management (FRM) unit, Legal and Compliance Directorate. [GRI 103-1]

The prevention of possibilities of fraud in PermataBank is conducted by several measures, including:

a) Issuing fraud alerts in writing form, that are distributed via email, containing information to all employees regarding the trends/modes of fraud that are developing with the aim of building recognition and awareness to fraud risk.
b) Through Anti-Fraud webinar and e-learning, which is an online training aimed at increasing fraud awareness, which is delivered in the form of discussion, animation followed by a quiz, which is mandatory for all employees of PermataBank.
c) Internal training/sharing session conducted by the FRM unit for the education on risks and forms/trends of fraud in banking. [GRI 103-2]

# Program Anti Pencucian Uang dan Pencegahan Pendanaan Terorisme

PermataBank melakukan pengelolaan untuk mencegah terjadinya tindak pidana pencucian uang yang dikelola oleh Anti-Money Laundering (AML). AML memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab atas pengelolaan harian dan koordinasi terhadap penerapan program Anti Pencucian Uang dan Pencegahan Pendanaan Terorisme (APU PPT) yang terbagi atas 2 bagian yaitu:

1. AML Advisory bertanggung jawab mengkoordinasikan dan mengawasi kepatuhan dan pelaksanaan dari kebijakan dan prosedur APU PPT.
2. AML Operations bertanggung jawab melakukan pemantauan transaksi nasabah, memberikan rekomendasi terkait pelaporan transaksi keuangan mencurigakan dan hal-hal terkait kegiatan operasional AML lainnya.

Selama tahun 2021, beberapa inisiatif yang telah dilaksanakan untuk mendukung program APU PPT antara lain:

1. Melakukan penyesuaian dan penyempurnaan terhadap kebijakan, prosedur, sistem, dan formulir CDD sesuai dengan Peraturan OJK No. 23/POJK.01/2019.
2. Melanjutkan program sertifikasi Anti Pencucian Uang untuk karyawan yang berhubungan dengan nasabah.
3. Melakukan review yang lebih mendalam atas nasabah dengan kategori high risk, Politically Exposed Person, dan instansi Pemerintahan.
4. Melakukan penyempurnaan dalam menentukan tingkat risiko cabang/regional dan juga kecukupan dalam menentukan jumlah Unit Kerja Khusus (UKK).
5. Bekerja sama dengan unit bisnis dan teknologi informasi dalam pengembangan proses penyaringan terhadap data teroris dan daftar hitam lainnya dalam upaya mendukung pembukaan rekening melalui digital channel.
6. Membangun AML Awareness melalui media internal PermataBank ataupun penerapan APU-PPT di cabang.
7. Melakukan proses penyempurnaan terhadap jangka waktu (TAT) untuk penutupan alert atas transaksi nasabah yang tidak wajar.
8. Melakukan penyesuaian parameter atas skenario alert pada sistem AML. [GRI 103-2, 205-2]

# Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Program

PermataBank conducts the management to prevent the occurrence of money laundering, which is managed by Anti-Money Laundering (AML). The AML is responsible for the day-to-day management and coordination of the Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (AML CFT) program implementation, which is divided into 2 parts, namely:

1. AML Advisory, which is responsible for coordinating and supervising the compliance and implementation of AML CFT Policies and Procedures.
2. AML Operations, which is responsible for monitoring customer transactions, providing recommendations related to the reporting of suspicious financial transactions and other matters related to other AML operational activities.

During 2021, several initiatives have been carried out to support the AML CFT program, among others:

1. Adjusting and refining the CDD policies, procedures, systems, and forms in accordance with the OJK Regulation No. 23/POJK.01/2019.
2. Continuing the Anti-Money Laundering certification program for employees who are in direct contact with customers.
3. Conducting a more comprehensive review on customers in the high risk, Politically Exposed Person category, and the Government institutions.
4. Making improvement in determining risk levels of branches/regions and the adequacy in determining the number of Special Units (SU).
5. Collaborating with the business and information technology units in the development of a filtering system on terrorist and other black list data in an effort to support account opening through digital channels.
6. Building AML Awareness through PermataBank internal media as well as AML CFT implementation in branches.
7. Performing a refining process on the Turn Around Time (TAT) period for closing alerts of irregular customer transactions.
8. Adjusting the parameters for the alert scenarios in the AML system. [GRI 103-2, 205-2]

# Manajemen Risiko

## Risk Management [GRI 102-11]

Secara strategis, PermataBank menerapkan manajemen risiko melalui Komite Pemantau Risiko (RMoC) pada tingkat Dewan Komisaris. Pada tingkat Direksi terdapat Komite Manajemen Risiko (RMC), Komite Aset & Liabilitas (ALCO), dan Komite Manajemen Risiko Terintegrasi (KMRT). Proses manajemen risiko dimulai dari identifikasi risiko, pengukuran risiko, pemantauan risiko, dan pengendalian risiko. Bank telah menetapkan Kerangka Kerja Enterprise Risk Management sebagai pedoman pengelolaan risiko untuk semua tipe risiko material yang telah diidentifikasi.

## Identifikasi, Pengukuran, dan Pemantauan Risiko

### Pengukuran Risiko

Pengukuran risiko mengacu kepada semua aktivitas yang bertujuan untuk mengkuantifikasi tingkat risiko inheren dan dampaknya terhadap modal, pendapatan, dan/atau strategi Bank. Metodologi dalam pengukuran risiko dapat bervariasi berdasarkan pendekatan

Strategically, PermataBank implements risk management through the Risk Monitoring Committee (RMoC) at the Board of Commissioners' level. At the level of the Board of Directors, the Risk Management Committee (RMC), Assets & Liabilities Committee (ALCO), and Integrated Risk Management Committee (IRMC) have been established. The risk management process starts from risk identification, risk measurement, risk monitoring, and risk controlling. The Bank has set up Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) as the guideline to manage the risks for all material risk types that has been identified.

## Risk Identification, Assessment, and Monitoring

### Risk Measurement

For certain risk types, the measurement of the risk level could be indicated by risk metrics.

The Bank continuously develop the methodology to ensure that all potential risks has been captured well in an objective and consistent approach, comply with the regulations and the Basel standards as the international guidelines for risk management practice, as well as refer to common practices that applicable in the industry.

Risk measurement could be performed in daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, or annually basis, according to the characteristic of each risk types. The Bank prioritize to use automation and continued to digitized the process in measuring the risks to provide a more reliable report. Risk measurement is performed for both under normal and stress condition to give complete picture of the level of risk facing by the Bank in various scenario.

## Risk Reporting

PermataBank continuously monitor the risk exposures through regular reporting to be able to track, evaluate, and escalate the risk levels and the effectiveness of responses implemented in the Bank. It is the basis for management to act promptly if and when the nature, potential impact, or likelihood of the risk breach the risk appetite, risk tolerance, or risk limits. It also to create new strategies or update older strategies which may have proved to be ineffective, ascertain the compliance of the policies, to review whether new risks are identified, to review whether previous assumptions in particular risks are still valid, to ensure whether the organization took appropriate risk to achieve its objectives, and to understand the effect of current risk level to the internal or external operating environment, or vice versa.

# Manajemen Risiko Terkait Lingkungan dan Sosial

## Environmental and Social Related Risk Management

Pengelolaan risiko terkait lingkungan dan sosial, telah diterapkan sebagai bagian dari risiko kredit dimana dalam memberikan kredit untuk industri tertentu, debitur wajib untuk memenuhi persyaratan *Environment and Social Requirement Assessment (ESRA)*. PermataBank menyadari bahwa dampak utama terhadap lingkungan hidup dan masalah sosial dapat timbul akibat dari keputusan pemberian kredit, untuk itu:

1. Seluruh proposal kredit harus menyertakan pertimbangan atas masalah-masalah lingkungan dan sosial, dimana saja hal tersebut diperlukan.
2. Seluruh pengajuan kredit harus mempertimbangkan standar lingkungan dan sosial yang berlaku baik secara internasional maupun melalui hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku di Indonesia.
3. Risiko yang berkaitan dengan masalah lingkungan dan sosial dikenali, dievaluasi, dan jika relevan, dimitigasi secara lebih baik.

Dalam proses pemberian kredit baik pada saat inisiasi maupun kajian tahunan, unit bisnis harus memastikan bahwa bagi industri tertentu wajib memastikan dokumen terkait lingkungan hidup sebagaimana diwajibkan oleh peraturan perundang-undangan tersedia atau menyerahkan salinan laporan/pengumuman dalam hal risiko lingkungan hidup dan sosial kepada PermataBank. Selain itu, bagi industri berisiko tinggi, apabila diperlukan unit Manajemen Risiko atau penyetuju kredit dapat memberikan kondisi/persyaratan spesifik untuk memastikan bahwa PermataBank dilindungi/dimitigasi dari risiko lingkungan hidup dan sosial nasabah tersebut.

Environmental and social risk management has been implemented as part of credit risk, in which to provide credit to certain industries, debtors are required to meet the Environment and Social Requirement Assessment (ESRA) requirements. PermataBank is aware that the main impact on the environment and social issues may arise as a result of the loan approval decision, therefore:

1. All credit proposals must include consideration of environmental and social issues, where appropriate.
2. All credit applications must consider environmental and social standards that apply both internationally and through applicable laws and regulations in Indonesia.
3. Risks related to environmental and social issues are identified, evaluated, and if relevant, mitigated better.

In the lending process, both at the time of initiation and annual review, the business unit must ensure that certain industries are required to ensure that documents related to the environment as required by laws and regulations are available or submit copies of reports/announcements regarding environmental and social risks to PermataBank. In addition, for high-risk industries, if necessary, the Risk Management unit or credit approval unit can provide specific conditions/requirements to ensure that PermataBank is protected/mitigated from the environmental and social risks of these customers.

Laporan ini memuat pernyataan yang diminta dalam Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 51/POJK.03/2017 tanggal 18 Juli 2017 tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten dan Perusahaan Publik (POJK 51/2017), khususnya Lampiran II. Selain itu, laporan ini juga mengacu pada Standar Global Reporting Initiatives (GRI), pilihan: Inti (Core). Indeks kedua acuan tersebut dapat dilihat di halaman 139 laporan ini. [GRI 102-54]

### Perubahan-perubahan terhadap Laporan Sebelumnya

Pada tanggal 30 Desember 2021, PermataBank telah menjual porsi kepemilikan saham pada anak perusahaan yaitu PT Sahabat Finansial Keluarga kepada pihak ketiga. PermataBank issued the Sustainability Report annually.
[GRI 102-50, 102-52]

Additionally, this report also refers to the Global Reporting Initiatives (GRI) Standard, option: Core. The index of the two references can be viewed on page 139 of this report. [GRI 102-54]

### External Assurance
